listing.name: Armored Core 4 — Project Glintburn AC4-Port (SulphurS16)
listing.summary: The project describes missions, settings and play, with an SPU interpreter fallback. Portcove has not tested gameplay. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA BLUS30027 disc folder containing PS3_GAME. Supply your own firmware 4.93 PUP and use RPCS3 for one-time decryption. This guide does not specify the exact supported disc revision; check the project’s requirements before setup.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Run the release launcher with your own dump. It downloads a compiler of approximately 250 MB and compiles the game locally.

warnings: The project describes missions, settings and play, with an SPU interpreter fallback. Portcove has not tested gameplay.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
